svg.aria-label: Array factor of the eight elements with every commanded phase at zero, in dB from each pattern's peak, from -90 to +90 degrees. Uncalibrated, the beam points to +6.0 degrees and the highest sidelobe is -7.8 dB. Calibrated, the beam is at broadside and the highest sidelobe is -12.8 dB.
